title: FEBCO 765 repair-kit finder and winterization record
description: Choose the FEBCO 765 size band and service task to find the official bonnet, poppet, check, or rubber-parts kit family.
summary: FEBCO publishes different 765 kit numbers for 1/2–3/4, 1–1 1/4, and 1 1/2–2 inch assemblies. Match both the size band and failed component.
statusNote: The official product record includes repair parts, freeze-detection information, and winterization instructions. Local testing requirements still control return to service.
diagramAlt: Pressure vacuum breaker showing bonnet, atmospheric vent, check assembly, and test cocks
identifiers: The raised bonnet and air inlet identify the pressure-vacuum-breaker layout.
The body label should show FEBCO and Series 765 before these kits are used.
Bonnet, poppet, check, and rubber kits solve different service scopes.

kits.contents: Bonnet, O-ring, spring, E-ring, washer, and stem.
kits.compatibility: Series 765, published 1/2 and 3/4 inch size band.

kits.contents: Bonnet hardware plus rubber disc and poppet.
kits.compatibility: Use when both upper assembly and poppet scope are confirmed.
Does not replace the bonnet or vent components.

kits.contents: O-ring, rubber disc, and check disc.
kits.compatibility: Inspect hard parts and freeze damage before choosing rubber-only service.

kits.contents: Bonnet, O-ring, spring, E-ring, washer, and stem.
kits.compatibility: Series 765, published 1 and 1 1/4 inch size band.

kits.contents: Bonnet hardware plus rubber disc and poppet.
kits.compatibility: Confirm that the body is not cracked or freeze distorted.
Series 765 only; verify nominal size on the body.

kits.contents: O-ring, rubber disc, and check disc.
kits.compatibility: Rubber-only kit does not address damaged seats, bonnet, or body.

kits.compatibility: Series 765, published 1 1/2 and 2 inch size band.
